release_notes.en:
### What's New in ArgonMusic v3.2.9

• **Redesigned Explore Moods & Genres Cards**: Full-bleed atmospheric visual mood and genre cards with cover artwork / seeded gradients, top-left bold titles, category pills, and a sleek header bar.
• **Built-in Addons Hub in Settings**: Dedicated Built-in Addons category in Settings to enable, disable, and configure Lossless Catalog Modules, Spotify Canvas & Motion Art, Live Synced Lyrics, Shazam Recognition, Discord Rich Presence, Listen Together, Last.fm Scrobbler, Gemini AI, and 8D Audio DSP.
• **Fixed Pause/Resume Play-Pause Icon State Bugs**: Fixed Rust playback state reporting 'buffering' while paused, fixed Fullscreen Now Playing not rebuilding transport icons on pause/resume, and ensured Android MediaSession notification play/pause stays synchronized.
• **Upgraded Library & Home UI + Scroll Type Option**: Added a Scroll Type setting (Bouncing, Clamping, Snap) in Settings -> Appearance, upgraded Library with quick-jump stats, playlist search filter, sort toggle, and Grid/List switcher, and added a Jump Back In quick-access grid on Home.
